scope: A editorial candidate before demo routes

visual_review.method: Poppler 65 dpi render; all 30 pages inspected in six contact sheets; dense pages checked with extracted text and layout bounds
visual_review.observed: No clipped text, table collision or missing arrows in inspected renders; preserved brand covers. NG p4 illustration height adjusted 100→85 pt to retain legibility without reducing body font.

text_parity: All manuscript text blocks and table cells found in corresponding PDF page and semantic HTML
fonts: Exact historical font hashes; official LibreOffice download archives verified
